name: Neocraft AI Product Images Generator for WooCommerce
author: Gplugins

sections.description:
AI Product Images Generator for WooCommerce helps you generate product images directly from the WooCommerce product editor.

Check all products feature here : AI Product Images Generator Features

Very simple use

  1. Upload your product image (transparent or solid background)
  2. Describe few words what this product is (in your language)
  3. Describe the desired background (optional)
  4. Generate

Why use Black Forest Flux 2 AI model?

Flux 2 is simply the best image-generation model currently available at a very affordable price. It allows you to generate professional, realistic renders suitable for marketing use. It is also one of the few models that lets you combine multiple images…

Improve image generation with PRO version

FREE vs PRO

✓ AI models choice : Klein (basic) & Pro (premium)
✓ Up to 4 images generates
✓ Up to 8 reference images
✓ Images combinations option
✓ Default custom prompt option

Get PRO

External Services

This plugin connects to Black Forest Labs (BFL) to generate AI product images.

What the service is and what it is used for:
– Black Forest Labs provides the image generation API used by this plugin to create AI product images from the WooCommerce product editor.

What data is sent and when:
– When you start an image generation request, the plugin sends your prompt text to Black Forest Labs.
– The plugin also sends the selected model and generation settings needed to create the image, such as width, height, quantity, and generation mode.
– If you choose to upload a reference image for generation, that image is also sent to Black Forest Labs.
– After a generation request is started, the plugin sends follow-up requests to Black Forest Labs to check the status of the generation job and retrieve the final result.

Terms of service: Black Forest TOS
Privacy policy: Black Forest Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/neocraft-ai-product-images-generator-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Configure the plugin from the Neocraft AI Product Images Generator for WooCommerce settings page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does this plugin use external services?

Yes. It uses Black Forest Labs for AI image generation. See the External Services section above for details.

How to get an API Key?

Follow instructions here : Get your Flux API Key

Where to get support?

Contact us here : Support
